params.prompt: Premium Korean mobile-app performance ad key visual for Meta feed, 4:5 vertical. High-end glossy 3D render, studio lighting, soft shadows, crisp details, eye-catching. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no money. Leave the upper 35% of the frame as clean empty background for a big headline and the bottom 15% clean for a CTA button. Concept: me versus peers. Two 3D podium-like bar columns rise from a glossy smartphone screen: a tall glowing orange column with small simple person icons on top representing peers, and a short translucent red dashed column with a single highlighted person icon and a red question badge. Warm cream background with soft orange glow, dynamic low camera angle.
